key_line: O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
Please, O Lord, let the man of God You sent us come to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born.
My heart rejoices in the LORD; my horn is exalted in the LORD.
note: The text says "Hannah prayed," but it is also known as Hannah's song. Keep or cut?

key_line: O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.
Please strike these people with blindness.
You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth.
O LORD, God of Israel, You are righteous!
For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.
Yet not as I will, but as You will.
God, I thank You that I am not like other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
note: A proud prayer by the Pharisee in Jesus' parable, the example not to follow. Keep or cut?

who: The believers gathered in Jerusalem (the apostles and disciples)
The believers, the early followers of Jesus
